Class ChaosPlatform

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.bootstrap.ChaosPlatform
public final class ChaosPlatform extends Object
The supported entry point of the agent's bootstrap module: framework integrations, test code and applications reach the agent through this class, not through ChaosAgentBootstrap or the other bootstrap types, whose signatures may change in any release.

This class exposes the three operations that external callers (test code, framework integrations) need:

  • installLocally() — ensure the agent is installed and return the control plane. Safe to call multiple times; idempotent.
  • current() — retrieve the already-installed control plane, or throw if the agent has not been installed.
  • installed() — the already-installed control plane, or empty: the probe for "is the agent installed?", which never throws.

The methods delegate directly to ChaosAgentBootstrap without adding any state of their own.

All three return the same control plane: the one the agent installed for the whole JVM, which every test, framework integration, management endpoint and the plan file poller share. Its ChaosControlPlane.close() throws UnsupportedOperationException: close the handles and sessions you opened instead, or activate through a TrackingChaosControlPlane (chaos-agent-testkit) and call its stopTracked().

  • Method Details

    • installLocally

      public static ChaosControlPlane installLocally()
      Ensures the chaos agent is installed in the current JVM and returns the ChaosControlPlane.

      Delegates to ChaosAgentBootstrap.installForLocalTests(), which performs a ByteBuddy self-attach if the agent has not yet been installed. If the agent was already installed (e.g., via -javaagent:), the existing control plane is returned immediately.

      Returns:
      the JVM-wide ChaosControlPlane, which cannot be closed; never null
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if dynamic self-attach is unavailable on this JVM
      See Also:
      • ChaosAgentBootstrap.installForLocalTests()

      Returns:

      Throws:

    • installed

      public static Optional<ChaosControlPlane> installed()
      Returns the ChaosControlPlane of the installed chaos runtime, or empty when the agent is not (yet) installed. Never installs the agent and never throws: use it to ask whether the agent is installed, instead of catching the exception of current().
      Returns:
      the JVM-wide ChaosControlPlane, which cannot be closed, or empty
